notes.title: Full release of v1.0
notes.notes:
Today the game has finished its trip in Early Access and launched as a final game.

Several new levels, monsters and challenges is added since the last update. With each level the challenge is harder and the likely-hood of needing to retry more than once to pass it is increased noticeably.

Would like to thank those that have tried it and reported problems or given suggestions during the Early Access phase. Without you it would not have been 30 updates published.

There is no planned content updates to the game, and absolutely no paid DLCs or any such nonsense, but if the game end up selling over a thousand copies there is a good chance for some additional candy to be introduced.

For those that one day end up trying out the game - thank you!
